nodes.display_name: Science in Cooking: A Bouncy Egg
nodes.long_description:
1. add vinegar and water to each cup
2. crack one egg into each cup
3. observe what happens to the eggs
4. remove the eggs from the cups and compare them
5. add food coloring to the bouncing eggs
nodes.short_description: Experience the cooking process of making egg bouncy balls in virtual reality to understand and learn about the fun scientific phenomena behind it.
